title: 第17章  见面礼长剑冰痕第18章  天下没有免费的午餐
slug: 御兽我契约的皆可返祖
content_zh:
嗷呜～
冰寒霜狼看着自己身上的伤口，凶厉的目光在观察云绒狐的同时，也在原地不断徘徊。
“铜头铁骨豆腐腰，雪球，攻击它的腰部。”
夜离殇观察着冰寒霜狼的情况，向着云绒狐发出指令。
呜嘤～
云绒狐答应一声，脚下出现湛蓝色的光芒，施展出自己的天赋云绒踏雪，向着冰寒霜狼靠近。
而冰寒霜狼也在此时奔跑起来，闪烁寒光的利爪抓向云绒狐。
云绒狐灵巧的躲开冰寒霜狼的攻击，并施展出第二个天赋能力云绒盾。
云绒盾施展出来的瞬间，云绒狐的绒毛上覆盖上一层冰甲，继而一头撞在冰寒霜狼的腹部，将冰寒霜狼给撞飞出去。
“使用冰锥乘胜追击。”
“依旧攻击其腹部的弱点。”
夜离殇再一次下达指令。
云绒狐尾巴一甩，又是三枚冰锥射向冰寒霜狼的腹部。
摔在地上的冰寒霜狼，还未来得及起身，就被冰锥洞穿腹部，嫣红的鲜血喷涌而出，染红了周围的地面。
“补刀。”
夜离殇看着冰寒霜狼的情况，向着云绒狐吩咐道。
呜嘤～
云绒狐尾巴一甩，三枚冰锥从不同角度射向冰寒霜狼的头部。
冰寒霜狼在地上不断挣扎着，再被冰锥洞穿头部时，发出一声悲鸣，继而瘫倒在地上。
“这……这有点残忍了吧。”

平台上，有人忍不住说了一句。
“残忍？”
“你等会下去的时候，你不要放出御兽，你看看它吃你的时候会不会温柔一点。”
洛星燃朝说话的人方向看了一眼，语气不咸不淡地说。。
嗯～
虽然她和夜离殇之间不对付，也总是看看夜离殇各种不顺眼，但对于夜离殇的做法，她还是非常认同的。
人类和妖兽之间可不是什么和平共处，友好往来的关系，而是弱肉强食的敌对关系。
高等级的妖兽，发动兽潮攻击人类城池的事情比比皆是，每次兽潮都会死伤无数，而且在和妖兽的对抗中，人类大多数的时候都是处于劣势的，甚至属于人类的领地也在不断被妖兽所摧毁、占领。
所以杀妖兽，在洛星燃看来是再正常不过的事情了，至于同情什么的，那是根本不存在的。
还是那句话，觉得杀妖兽残忍，那遇到妖兽的时候，你看它吃你的时候会不会温柔一点。
“夜同学的战术安排很优秀，善于利用妖兽的弱点进行攻击，这一点很值得学习。”
“洛同学说的也很对，不要觉得击杀妖兽很残忍，你们现在能够安稳地生活，在这里学习，全靠前线的御兽师们拼命守护。”
“等你们见到妖兽发动兽潮，攻城的时候，你们就知道了。”
凌沧海扫视众人一眼后，就默默收回了自己的目光。
而夜离殇也在此时抱着云绒狐回到平台上，在自己的座位上坐下。
“玄冥，你去清理一下，就当给你加餐了。”
凌沧海看着自己的御兽吩咐道。
玄冥巨蟒点点头，就冲了出去，将冰寒霜狼的尸体吞了下去。
凌沧海再一次按动手中的遥控器，战斗训练区域的铁笼降了下去，一个新的铁笼升上来。
“这第三次尝试，就由你去吧。”

凌沧海的目光看向刚才那位说残忍的学生。
content_en:
Ouch~
The Ice Frost Wolf looked at the wounds on his body, and while observing the Cloud Velvet Fox with his ferocious eyes, he also kept wandering in place.
"Bronze-headed and iron-bone tofu waist, Snowball, attack its waist."
Ye Lishang observed the situation of the Frost Wolf and gave instructions to the Cloud Velvet Fox.
Woohoo~
Cloud Velvet Fox agreed, and a blue light appeared under his feet. He used his talent, Cloud Velvet Steps on the Snow, and approached the Frost Wolf.
The Ice Frost Wolf also started running at this time, grabbing the Cloud Velvet Fox with its sharp claws that shone with cold light.
The cloud velvet fox nimbly avoided the attack of the frost wolf and used its second talent, the cloud velvet shield.
The moment the Cloud Velvet Shield was released, the Cloud Velvet Fox's fur was covered with a layer of ice armor, and then it hit the Ice Frost Wolf's abdomen, knocking the Ice Frost Wolf away.
"Use the ice pick to pursue the victory."
"Still attacking the weak point in its abdomen."
Ye Li Shang gave the order again.
The Cloud Velvet Fox flicked its tail, and three more ice picks were shot at the Frost Wolf's abdomen.
The Frost Wolf fell to the ground. Before he could get up, an ice pick pierced his abdomen. Bright red blood spurted out, dyeing the surrounding ground red.
"Last hit."
Ye Lishang looked at the situation of the Frost Wolf and gave instructions to the Cloud Velvet Fox.
Woohoo~
The cloud fox flicked its tail, and three ice picks shot at the frost wolf's head from different angles.
The Frost Wolf kept struggling on the ground, and when an ice pick pierced its head, it let out a mournful cry and then collapsed to the ground.
"This...this is a bit cruel."
On the platform, someone couldn't help but say something.
"Cruel?"
"When you go down later, don't release the beast. See if it will be gentler when it eats you."
Luo Xingran glanced in the direction of the speaker and spoke in a neutral tone. .
Hmm~
Although she and Ye Lizhang didn't get along with each other, and she always looked at Ye Lizhang's various displeasures, she still very much agreed with Ye Lizhang's actions.
The relationship between humans and monsters is not a peaceful coexistence and friendly exchanges, but a hostile relationship of the jungle and the strong.
It is common for high-level monsters to launch monster waves to attack human cities. Each monster wave will cause countless casualties. Moreover, in the confrontation with monsters, humans are at a disadvantage most of the time. Even the territories belonging to humans are constantly being destroyed and occupied by monsters.
Therefore, killing monsters is a normal thing in Luo Xingran's opinion. As for sympathy, it does not exist at all.
Again, if you think killing a monster is cruel, then when you encounter a monster, see if it will be gentler when it eats you.
"Classmate Ye's tactical arrangements are very good and he is good at exploiting the weaknesses of monsters to attack. This is worth learning."
"Classmate Luo is right. Don't think that killing monsters is cruel. You can live peacefully and study here because of the dedicated protection of the frontline beast masters."
"You will know when you see the monsters launching a wave of beasts and attacking the city."
After Ling Canghai glanced at everyone, he silently withdrew his gaze.
At this time, Ye Lishang returned to the platform with Yunrong Hu in his arms and sat down in his seat.
"Xuan Ming, go and clean up. I'll treat it like an extra meal for you."
Ling Canghai looked at his beast and ordered.
The Mysterious Python nodded, rushed out, and swallowed the body of the Frost Wolf.
Ling Canghai pressed the remote control in his hand again, and the iron cage in the combat training area lowered, and a new iron cage rose up.
"This third try is up to you."
Ling Canghai looked at the student who said cruel words just now.
